Message:
scsi: hpsa: Fix memory leak in hpsa_init_one()

When hpsa_scsi_add_host() fails, h->lastlogicals is leaked since it is
missing a free() in the error handler.

Fix this by adding free() when hpsa_scsi_add_host() fails.
